## **Pression publicitaire** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Pression publicitaire.**
      1 avis récent mentionne pression publicitaire.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 1 sept. 2026 - 1 sept. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs remarquent la pression publicitaire. Cela signale une friction de monétisation et une ouverture pour un concurrent plus propre.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Marion Elliott_, 1 sept. 2026, 1/5: "The Fitbit app was absolutely fine. This one that you've forced upon me as a Fitbit user, is not intuitive, not attractive, my info is not easily accessible and it pushes too many ads for itself. Not good at all."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs et stabilité** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      2 avis récents mentionnent bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 5 août 2026 - 4 sept. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent des crashes ou de l'instabilité. À traiter comme actionnable seulement en cas de pic ou après une mise à jour ; sinon souvent du bruit de baseline.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Christian Arpit_, 4 sept. 2026, 1/5: "There have been a lot of bugs since the last update. I walk the same ground every day and complete three laps; previously, it showed a distance of 6.2–6.5 km. For the past two days, it's shown 4.5 km for the same three laps, and today it's showing 9.77 km for the same distance. Please fix this bug.please make it accurate."
            2. _S M_, 4 sept. 2026, 1/5: "always 1000s of steps off from fitbit, everything is linked ive linked and unlinked and cleared cache but this app always shorts you. Why do we have 2 apps? Google Health actually ready your fitbit steps, i don't understand wht we still have Google fit when its so unreliable. 3 stars tons of complaints and you still won't fix your broken app"
            3. _Simon_, 5 août 2026, 1/5: "broken af. the entire screen keeps loading forever when the app has no internet even tho i know exactly what it should be showing me but its just UNUSABLE if it doesmt habe internet Access 24/7"
<!--/ir-theme-->
